svg.title: Linear issue intake
svg.desc: Canonical IDs, trusted scope and exact reviewed content decide whether an existing issue is reusable. The scenario tables cover holds, active attempts, duplicates and delivered follow-ups without creating competing work.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 1. Lead looks up the request in Linear

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 2. Is the existing issue reusable here?

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 3. Lead reviews new or changed task prose

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 4. Tool confirms the issue and links the CLI

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 7. CLI shows Todo and its dependencies

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 8. CLI shows the existing state or intake blocker
